technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term support but weak momentum confirmation, low ADX trend strength, and compressed volatility suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 17 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales 67-76 days ago) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 348 crisis regime, rising DXY, CPI event in 2 days) combined with earnings in 17 days creates severe risk environment for ABBV.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with RSI-9 rising and extreme fear sentiment (19/100) offers contrarian entry near support (119.48) ahead of potential relief bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 17 days, VIX crisis regime, inverted yield curve, weak momentum (no MACD confirmation, ADX false, EMA-9/21 bearish), and below-average volume create compounding risks that outweigh technical support.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (19/100) and price at support (119.48) above 200-EMA offer contrarian appeal, the combination of earnings in 17 days, VIX crisis regime, inverted yield curve, and weak momentum confirmation (no MACD, ADX false, EMA-9/21 bearish) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical support.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 17 days combined with macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, CPI event in 2 days) could trigger sharp drawdown regardless of technical support level.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; debate decisively favors bear case
